primary_goal: Select tasks where memory injection has plausible verifier outcome impact (solved=false -> solved=true) based on objective evidence.

scoring_rules.name: task_specific_memory_available
scoring_rules.description: Task has >= 1 memory card with task_id matching the candidate, or retrieval_hints including task_id.

scoring_rules.name: prior_verifier_fail
scoring_rules.description: Candidate has at least one verifier_result with status FAIL or VERIFIER_EXECUTED_FAIL in prior evals.

scoring_rules.name: no_prior_real_model_ab_tested
scoring_rules.description: Candidate has NOT been tested with a real model A/B (memory_on vs memory_off) in eval-9 or prior evals.

scoring_rules.name: has_memory_off_arm_missing
scoring_rules.description: memory_off arm was never run (adds urgency — comparison delta not yet known).

hard_exclusions: C_12481 unless objective score >50 AND not previously tested in eval-9
c_12481_exclusion_rationale: C_12481 was already run in eval-9 with real model A/B. memory_on and memory_off both FAIL. No solved delta. Including it again would not yield new information unless a fundamentally different retrieval strategy is used.
note: Selection is for MEMORY-EVAL-11 real model A/B execution only. No uplift claim is made at this stage.
